    <style type="text/css">
      /* Custom CSS */
      
      
      /* Each table gets its own horizontal scroll, scoped to itself, so the
         markdown container doesn't grow a second outer scrollbar that fights
         with the scroll on adjacent code blocks. */
      .scalar-app .markdown table {
        display: block;
        max-width: 100%;
        width: max-content;
        overflow-x: auto;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      }
      .scalar-app .markdown table th,
      .scalar-app .markdown table td {
        word-break: normal !important;
        overflow-wrap: normal !important;
      }
      
      .scalar-app .markdown a {
        color: #f59e0b;
      }
      .scalar-app .markdown a:hover {
        color: #fbbf24;
      }
      
      /* Hide Scalar's native download UI — we surface it via the floating
         action cluster (see .ph-fab-cluster below) for layout consistency. */
      .scalar-app .download-container { display: none !important; }
      
      /* Hide "Powered by Scalar" sidebar footer link. */
      .scalar-app a[href="https://www.scalar.com"] { display: none !important; }
      
      /* Hide Scalar's IDE/MCP quick-launch buttons (VS Code, Cursor, Generate MCP).
         These render in the sidebar regardless of showDeveloperTools. We target
         by URL scheme so the rule survives class-name renames across Scalar
         versions, plus the section wrapper via :has() in case the buttons render
         inside a labeled group. */
      .scalar-app a[href^="vscode:"],
      .scalar-app a[href^="vscode-insiders:"],
      .scalar-app a[href^="cursor:"],
      .scalar-app a[href*="mcp.scalar.com"],
      .scalar-app a[href*="generate-mcp"],
      .scalar-app a[href*="modelcontextprotocol"] { display: none !important; }
      .scalar-app section:has(> a[href^="vscode:"]),
      .scalar-app section:has(> a[href^="cursor:"]) { display: none !important; }
      
      /* Hide Scalar's "Ask AI" feature (sidebar button + any floating widget).
         Targeted by attribute and class fragments, case-insensitive, since the
         CDN bundle may rename the underlying classes between releases. */
      .scalar-app [class*="ask-ai" i],
      .scalar-app [class*="askai" i],
      .scalar-app [class*="ai-assistant" i],
      .scalar-app [aria-label*="Ask AI" i],
      .scalar-app [title*="Ask AI" i],
      .scalar-app button[data-feature="ask-ai" i] { display: none !important; }
      
      /* Full-width prose for sections with no right-column code samples (Quick Start,
         Auth, BYOP, CLI, MCP, Errors, Safety, plain Models/Account). Scalar lays
         each tag out as two flex columns; the right column stays empty for prose-
         only tags, wasting ~50% of the page. We collapse the empty column and let
         the prose stretch. The same rule fixes the section header row above. */
      .scalar-app .section-columns:has(> .section-column:nth-child(2):empty) > .section-column:first-child {
          flex: 1 1 100% !important;
          max-width: 100% !important;
      }
      .scalar-app .section-columns > .section-column:nth-child(2):empty {

<script>
(function () {
  // Copy for LLMs — always copies the full doc (api + integrations).
  var copy = document.querySelector('.ph-fab-copy');
  if (copy) {
    var label = copy.querySelector('span');
    copy.addEventListener('click', async function () {
      var res = await fetch('/docs/llm.txt');
      var text = await res.text();
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      var prev = label.textContent;
      label.textContent = 'Copied';
      setTimeout(function () { label.textContent = prev; }, 1200);
    });
  }
  // Text-based DOM scan for Scalar buttons whose class names get hashed
  // by the CDN bundle — we tag them by their stable label so our CSS can
  // hide ("Ask AI") or style ("Show more") them in amber.
  function scanScalarButtons() {
    var nodes = document.querySelectorAll('button, a, [role="button"]');
    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      var text = (nodes[i].textContent || '').trim();
      if (/^ask ai\b/i.test(text)) nodes[i].style.display = 'none';
      else if (/^show more\b/i.test(text)) nodes[i].classList.add('ph-show-more');
    }
  }
  scanScalarButtons();
  new MutationObserver(scanScalarButtons).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
})();
</script>

<h3>Text (Python, OpenAI SDK)</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-python"><span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> openai <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url=<span class="hljs-string">"https://gen.pollinations.ai"</span>, api_key=<span class="hljs-string">"YOUR_API_KEY"</span>)
response = client.chat.completions.create(model=<span class="hljs-string">"openai"</span>, messages=[{<span class="hljs-string">"role"</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"user"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"content"</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"Hello!"</span>}])
<span class="hljs-built_in">print</span>(response.choices[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>].message.content)
</code></pre>
<h3>Image (URL — no code needed)</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-perl">https:<span class="hljs-regexp">//g</span>en.pollinations.ai/image/a<span class="hljs-variable">%2</span>0cat<span class="hljs-variable">%2</span>0in<span class="hljs-variable">%20space</span>?model=flux
</code></pre>
<h3>Audio (cURL)</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">curl <span class="hljs-string">"https://gen.pollinations.ai/audio/Hello%20world?voice=nova"</span> \
  -H <span class="hljs-string">"Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"</span> -o speech.mp3
</code></pre>
<h3>Embeddings (OpenAI-compatible)</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">curl https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H <span class="hljs-string">"Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"</span> \
  -H <span class="hljs-string">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> \
  -d <span class="hljs-string">'{"model":"openai-3-small","input":"Hello world","dimensions":512}'</span>
</code></pre>
<p>See <code>GET /v1/models</code> for every text, image, audio, video, and embedding model available.</p>

<p>All generation requests require an API key from <a href="https://enter.pollinations.ai" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">enter.pollinations.ai</a>. Model listing endpoints work without authentication.</p>
<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Type</th>
      <th>Prefix</th>
      <th>Use case</th>
      <th>Rate limits</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td>Secret</td>
      <td><code>sk_</code></td>
      <td>Server-side apps</td>
      <td>None</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>Publishable</td>
      <td><code>pk_</code></td>
      <td>Client-side apps (beta)</td>
      <td>1 pollen/IP/hour</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<p>Two ways to authenticate:</p>
<ul>
  <li>Header: <code>Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY</code></li>
  <li>Query param: <code>?key=YOUR_API_KEY</code></li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
  <p><strong>Warning:</strong> Never expose secret keys (<code>sk_</code>) in client-side code. Use publishable keys (<code>pk_</code>) for frontend apps.</p>
</blockquote>
</div></div><div data-v-699c28e3="" class="section-column"><!----></div></div></div><!----></section><!----><!----></div></div></div><div data-placeholder="false" data-testid="lazy-container" class="section-columns"><div data-v-699c28e3="" class="section-column"><div class="markdown line-clamp-(--markdown-clamp)" style="--markdown-clamp: 7;">
<p>BYOP (Bring Your Own Pollen) lets your users authorize your app to spend their own Pollen on Pollinations requests. Your publishable App Key (<code>pk_...</code>) identifies the app; after approval, Pollinations returns a scoped user key (<code>sk_...</code>) for API calls.</p>
<p>Users stay in control of their balance, budgets, and revocation; your app never has to pay for their usage.</p>
<h2>🗝️ App Key</h2>
<p>An <strong>App Key</strong> (<code>pk_...</code>) is the publishable key your app sends users to Pollinations with. Without one, the consent screen falls back to the redirect hostname and traffic isn't attributed to your account.</p>
<p>To create one, go to <a href="https://enter.pollinations.ai" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">enter.pollinations.ai</a> → <strong>Create New App Key</strong>:</p>
<p align="left">
  <img src="https://media.pollinations.ai/1133540dc4c19635" alt="Edit App Key" width="420">
</p>
<p>Set the <strong>Name</strong> (shows on the consent screen). For web apps, add at least one <strong>Redirect URI</strong> (your exact callback URL). The key you get back is your <code>client_id</code> (a <code>pk_...</code> publishable key; the legacy name <code>app_key</code> is still accepted).</p>
<p>When a user lands on the consent screen signed-out, they're prompted to continue with GitHub:</p>
<p align="left">
  <img src="https://media.pollinations.ai/fbc04dd1c77dbfd8" alt="Authorize — signed out" width="420">
</p>
<p>Once signed in, they review the requested access and confirm:</p>
<p align="left">
  <img src="https://media.pollinations.ai/a7e4a1e9c5f48b8d" alt="Authorize — signed in" width="420">
</p>
<h2>Developer Earnings</h2>
<p>Developer earnings are opt-in per App Key. When enabled, users pay 25% over base rates. The markup credits to your balance.</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-text">Base request cost: 1.00 pollen
User pays:         1.25 pollen
You receive:       0.25 pollen
</code></pre>
<p>Credits land in the same balance type the user paid from: tier balance when the request used tier balance, paid balance when it used paid balance.</p>
<p>Pass <code>earningsEnabled: true</code> when creating an App Key via the API, or toggle it later from the dashboard:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">curl -X POST https://gen.pollinations.ai/account/keys \
  -H <span class="hljs-string">'Authorization: Bearer sk_yoursecretkey'</span> \
  -H <span class="hljs-string">'Content-Type: application/json'</span> \
  -d <span class="hljs-string">'{"name":"my-app","type":"publishable","redirectUris":["https://myapp.com/callback"],"earningsEnabled":true}'</span>
</code></pre>
<h2>⚙️ Web Apps (Redirect Flow)</h2>
<h3>1. Build the Auth Link</h3>
<p>With <code>client_id</code> (consent screen shows your app name + your GitHub):</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">https://enter.pollinations.ai/authorize?redirect_uri=https://myapp.com&client_id=pk_yourkey
</code></pre>
<p>Without (still works, just shows the hostname):</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">https://enter.pollinations.ai/authorize?redirect_uri=https://myapp.com
</code></pre>
<p>With restrictions:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">https://enter.pollinations.ai/authorize?redirect_uri=https://myapp.com&client_id=pk_yourkey&scope=usage&models=flux,openai&expiry=7&budget=10
</code></pre>
<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Param</th>
      <th>What it does</th>
      <th>Example</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><code>client_id</code></td>
      <td>Your publishable key — shows app name + author on consent screen, tracks traffic for tier upgrades</td>
      <td><code>pk_abc123</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code>redirect_uri</code></td>
      <td>Where users return after authorizing — receives the temp API key in the URL fragment</td>
      <td><code>https://myapp.com</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code>state</code></td>
      <td>Opaque value echoed back on the callback for CSRF protection</td>
      <td><code>any-random-string</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code>scope</code></td>
      <td>Account access (space or comma separated)</td>
      <td><code>usage keys</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code>models</code></td>
      <td>Restrict to specific models</td>
      <td><code>flux,openai,gptimage</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code>budget</code></td>
      <td>Numeric Pollen cap. Defaults to <code>5</code>; users can clear the budget field on the consent screen for unlimited.</td>
      <td><code>10</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code>expiry</code></td>
      <td>User-authorized key lifetime in days (default: 7)</td>
      <td><code>7</code></td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<p>Legacy names <code>app_key</code>, <code>redirect_url</code>, and <code>permissions</code> are still accepted for backwards compatibility.</p>
<h3>2. Handle the Redirect</h3>
<p>User comes back with a key in the URL fragment:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-perl">https:<span class="hljs-regexp">//m</span>yapp.com<span class="hljs-comment">#api_key=sk_abc123xyz</span>
</code></pre>
<p>Fragment, not query param — never hits server logs. 🔒 If you passed <code>state</code>, it's echoed back: <code>#api_key=sk_...&state=...</code>. On denial the fragment is <code>#error=access_denied&state=...</code>.</p>
<h3>💻 Code</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// Send user to auth</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> params = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">URLSearchParams</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">redirect_uri</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">client_id</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'pk_yourkey'</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// optional — shows app name + author</span>
});
<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">location</span>.<span class="hljs-property">href</span> = <span class="hljs-string">`https://enter.pollinations.ai/authorize?<span class="hljs-subst">${params}</span>`</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// Grab key from URL after redirect</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> apiKey = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">URLSearchParams</span>(location.<span class="hljs-property">hash</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>)).<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'api_key'</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// Use their pollen</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">method</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'POST'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">headers</span>: { <span class="hljs-string">'Authorization'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">`Bearer <span class="hljs-subst">${apiKey}</span>`</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'Content-Type'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'application/json'</span> },
  <span class="hljs-attr">body</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">model</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'openai'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">messages</span>: [{ <span class="hljs-attr">role</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'user'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">content</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'yo'</span> }] })
});
</code></pre>
<h2>🖥️ CLIs & Headless Apps (Device Flow)</h2>
<p>Same authorize screen, but the user opens a browser separately. Your CLI polls for the key.</p>
<p><strong>Where this fits:</strong></p>
<ul>
  <li><strong>Discord / Telegram / WhatsApp bots</strong> — bot DMs the code, user approves in browser, bot gets their key</li>
  <li><strong>CLI tools</strong> — <code>pollinations login</code> opens a browser, CLI waits for approval</li>
  <li><strong>MCP servers</strong> — AI agent requests access, user approves from their browser</li>
  <li><strong>Raspberry Pi / IoT</strong> — headless device displays a code, user approves on their phone</li>
  <li><strong>VS Code extensions</strong> — extension shows the code, user approves in browser</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash"><span class="hljs-comment"># 1. request a device code (pass your app_key as client_id for attribution)</span>
curl -X POST https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/device/code \
  -H <span class="hljs-string">'Content-Type: application/json'</span> \
  -d <span class="hljs-string">'{"client_id": "pk_yourkey", "scope": "generate"}'</span>
<span class="hljs-comment"># → { "device_code": "...", "user_code": "ABCD-1234", "verification_uri": "/device" }</span>

<span class="hljs-comment"># 2. tell user: "go to enter.pollinations.ai/device and enter ABCD-1234"</span>

<span class="hljs-comment"># 3. poll for the key (every 5s)</span>
curl -X POST https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/device/token \
  -H <span class="hljs-string">'Content-Type: application/json'</span> \
  -d <span class="hljs-string">'{"device_code": "..."}'</span>
<span class="hljs-comment"># pending → { "error": "authorization_pending" }</span>
<span class="hljs-comment"># done    → { "access_token": "sk_...", "token_type": "bearer", "scope": "generate" }</span>
</code></pre>
<h2>👤 Who's Using This Key?</h2>
<p>Once you have the user-authorized <code>sk_...</code> key, you can check who it belongs to:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">curl https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/device/userinfo \
  -H <span class="hljs-string">'Authorization: Bearer sk_...'</span>
<span class="hljs-comment"># → { "sub": "user-id", "name": "Thomas", "preferred_username": "voodoohop", "email": "...", "picture": "..." }</span>
</code></pre>
<p>Standard OIDC userinfo shape.</p>
<hr>
<p>🕐 User-authorized keys default to 7 days. Users can revoke anytime from the dashboard.</p>

class="section-columns"><div data-v-699c28e3="" class="section-column"><div class="markdown line-clamp-(--markdown-clamp)" style="--markdown-clamp: 7;">
<p>The Pollinations CLI — for humans, AI agents, and everything in between.</p>
<p>Generate text, images, audio, video from the terminal. Backed by the <a href="https://gen.pollinations.ai" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">Pollinations API</a>.</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">npx @pollinations/cli gen image <span class="hljs-string">"a cat in space"</span> --output cat.png
</code></pre>
<h2>For AI agents</h2>
<p>Point your coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex) at the skill file and it gets the full usage map — flags, stdin conventions, <code>--json</code> output shape, error codes, the lot:</p>
<blockquote>
  <p>Read <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pollinations/pollinations/main/packages/polli-cli/SKILL.md" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pollinations/pollinations/main/packages/polli-cli/SKILL.md</a> and follow the instructions to generate media with the <code>polli</code> CLI.</p>
</blockquote>
<p>The skill also ships inside the package: <code>node_modules/@pollinations/cli/SKILL.md</code>.</p>
<p>Every command is agent-friendly:</p>
<ul>
  <li><code>--json</code> — structured stdout, human messages to stderr. Safe to parse.</li>
  <li>Exit code <code>0</code> on success, non-zero on error.</li>
  <li>When a call runs out of pollen, the first line of the error is the top-up link.</li>
  <li><code>polli auth status --json</code> exposes everything about the current session.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Get started</h2>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">npm install -g @pollinations/cli     <span class="hljs-comment"># installs the `polli` binary</span>
polli auth login                         <span class="hljs-comment"># device-flow via enter.pollinations.ai</span>
<span class="hljs-built_in">printf</span> <span class="hljs-string">'%s'</span> <span class="hljs-string">"<span class="hljs-variable">$POLLINATIONS_API_KEY</span>"</span> | polli auth login --with-token
</code></pre>
<p>Credentials land at <code>~/.pollinations/credentials.json</code>. For one-off runs pass <code>--key sk_...</code> or set <code>POLLINATIONS_API_KEY</code>. Get keys at <a href="https://enter.pollinations.ai" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">enter.pollinations.ai</a>.</p>
<h2>Generate</h2>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">polli gen text <span class="hljs-string">"Explain quantum tunneling in one sentence"</span>
polli gen text <span class="hljs-string">"Summarize this"</span> < notes.md          <span class="hljs-comment"># stdin becomes context</span>
<span class="hljs-built_in">echo</span> <span class="hljs-string">"context"</span> | polli gen text <span class="hljs-string">"question"</span>

polli gen image <span class="hljs-string">"cyberpunk city at night"</span> --model flux --output city.png
polli gen image <span class="hljs-string">"enhance this"</span> --image https://media.pollinations.ai/abc --model gptimage

polli gen audio <span class="hljs-string">"Hello world"</span> --voice nova --output speech.mp3
polli gen audio <span class="hljs-string">"read it to me"</span> --play                <span class="hljs-comment"># plays back after saving (blocks until done)</span>
polli gen video <span class="hljs-string">"a waterfall in slow motion"</span> --duration 5 --output clip.mp4
polli gen transcribe speech.mp3

polli gen chat --model openai                         <span class="hljs-comment"># interactive multi-turn</span>
</code></pre>
<p><code>gen text</code> streams by default. File-output commands pick a sensible default path if <code>--output</code> is omitted.</p>
<h2>Discover</h2>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">polli models                 <span class="hljs-comment"># all models</span>
polli models --<span class="hljs-built_in">type</span> image    <span class="hljs-comment"># filter</span>
polli models --stats         <span class="hljs-comment"># health + perf (last 60m)</span>
polli docs                   <span class="hljs-comment"># full API reference in the terminal</span>
polli docs /image            <span class="hljs-comment"># one endpoint</span>
polli docs --open            <span class="hljs-comment"># open in browser</span>
</code></pre>
<h2>Account</h2>
<p>Two kinds of keys:</p>
<ul>
  <li><strong>Secret (<code>sk_</code>)</strong> — backend use, full access. Default.</li>
  <li><strong>Publishable (<code>pk_</code>)</strong> — safe to ship in frontend code.</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">polli keys list
polli keys create --name mybot --budget 100                    <span class="hljs-comment"># secret (default)</span>
polli keys create --name myapp --<span class="hljs-built_in">type</span> publishable              <span class="hljs-comment"># API publishable</span>
polli keys create --name myapp --<span class="hljs-built_in">type</span> publishable \            <span class="hljs-comment"># 3rd-party app key</span>
  --redirect-uri https://myapp.com/callback --earnings
polli keys revoke <<span class="hljs-built_in">id</span>>
</code></pre>
<p>Keys can't be edited — to change a name, budget, or model list, revoke and recreate. Publishable app keys default developer earnings off; pass <code>--earnings</code> to enable them.</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash">polli usage                  <span class="hljs-comment"># pollen balance</span>
polli usage --<span class="hljs-built_in">history</span>        <span class="hljs-comment"># recent requests</span>
polli usage --daily          <span class="hljs-comment"># daily spend</span>
</code></pre>
